verdict.rationale: monday.com provides generic AI-agent building blocks (event triggers like create_item, item assignment, 'spot risks and progress gaps', custom agent creation via natural language) that a user could configure to triage and prioritize incoming items, but there is no evidence of an out-of-the-box bug/task triage-and-prioritization feature — it would require custom agent setup. missing for 10: a documented native 'triage/prioritize bugs' template or feature, evidence of automatic prioritization logic (e.g. severity scoring), and independent confirmation it works as described.
